Question
========
National survey data shows that 69% of Canadians support mandatory childhood vaccinations. A local researcher believes that support is likely much higher in Toronto compared with the national average. Which of the following equations represents the research hypothesis?


Answerlist
----------

* $\mu > 0.69$

* $\mu < 0.69$

* $\mu = 0.69$

* $\mu \neq 0.69$
